stories.title: XYBench：協助解決問題背後的真正問題 / XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question

sources.title: XYBench：協助解決問題背後的真正問題 / XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.title_zh: XYBench：協助解決問題背後的真正問題
sources.title_en: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.title_original: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.summary_zh: 真正實用的 AI 助理需要能夠協助提出誤導性問題的使用者，而不僅僅是那些用適當詳細程度提出正確問題的使用者。我們推出了 XYBench，這是一個包含 8K+ 個問題的基準測試，用於測試 AI 助理如何回應基於誤解的請求，例如詢問如何讓從杯子蛋糕上滑落的糖霜變濃稠，但真正的問題是杯子蛋糕還太溫暖而不適合塗糖霜。XYBench 在 EMNLP 2026 上榮獲最佳資源論文獎。

sources.title_en: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
sources.title_original: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
sources.summary_zh: llama.cpp 讓在各種硬體上執行多模態 LLMs 成為可能——從消費級的本地機器到高階企業伺服器。透過量化、最佳化的後端以及可攜式的 C/C++ 實作，我們讓 AI 推論在軟體堆疊的每個層級都易於使用。我們相信這是建構跨平臺與隱私 AI 產品最輕量、最具多功能性且最合理的平臺。

stories.title: OpenAI 透過 ChatGPT Wallet 從頭重建人工智慧購物 / OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet

sources.title: OpenAI 透過 ChatGPT Wallet 從頭重建人工智慧購物 / OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 透過 ChatGPT Wallet 從頭重建人工智慧購物
sources.title_en: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.title_original: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.summary: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases. The article OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 在放棄其第一種方法 Instant Checkout 後，透過 ChatGPT Wallet 再次嘗試人工智慧驅動的購物。使用者註冊一次卡片後，即可透過 Face ID 或指紋確認每筆購買，而實際的卡片詳細資訊則隱藏在支付代幣後面。諸如 Anthropic、Meta 和 xAI 等競爭對手已經有其代理程式在進行購物。

stories.title: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 將 AI 直接接入工廠軟體以自動化工業工作流程 / Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows

sources.title: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 將 AI 直接接入工廠軟體以自動化工業工作流程 / Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 將 AI 直接接入工廠軟體以自動化工業工作流程
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that. The article Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 外掛程式將 AI 直接連線到 Autodesk Fusion、Oracle NetSuite 和 Infor。其 17 項專業技能讓 AI 能夠在獲得人工核准後，起草報價單、比較供應商並在交貨延遲時下達備份訂單。該外掛程式目前尚未控制實體機械，但 Anthropic 正在為此單獨開發模型硬體標準（Model Hardware Standard）。

stories.title: 銀行因美國出口管制，禁止中國與香港投資人參與 Anthropic 的 IPO / Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls

sources.title: 銀行因美國出口管制，禁止中國與香港投資人參與 Anthropic 的 IPO / Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.title_zh: 銀行因美國出口管制，禁止中國與香港投資人參與 Anthropic 的 IPO
sources.title_en: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.title_original: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.summary: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway. The article Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 《彭博社》報導，中國投資人被排除在 Anthropic's 的 IPO 之外。銀行以稱為 ITAR 的美國出口管制規則為由，拒絕來自中國大陸和香港的買入委託。SpaceX的 IPO 期間也適用類似的限制，而且 Anthropic's 的產品在兩個地區本來就無法使用。

sources.summary: Jensen Huang likely left Nvidia more because of risky business practices than anything else, a Wall Street Journal report suggests. At the very least, those practices made him enemies internally. The company offered cloud providers billions in financial guarantees for chip purchases, including a planned $250 billion deal with OpenAI. Interim CEO and then-CFO Colette Kress tried to contain the risk, and Huang reportedly didn't like that. The article Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life appeared first on The Decoder .

stories.title: 近 70% 的美國機關使用生成式 AI，而工會終於迎頭趕上並建立防護措施 / Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails

sources.title: 近 70% 的美國機關使用生成式 AI，而工會終於迎頭趕上並建立防護措施 / Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.title_zh: 近 70% 的美國機關使用生成式 AI，而工會終於迎頭趕上並建立防護措施
sources.title_en: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.title_original: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.summary: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI. The article Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 美國公部門工會正日益推動針對 AI 監控和自動化解僱的保護措施。在奧克蘭，一次罷工投票迫使資方實施再培訓計畫以取代裁員，而俄亥俄州的一個運輸工會則贏得了對自動駕駛車輛的否決權。加州禁止了所謂的「老闆軟體」（bossware）。所有這些都在近 70% 的美國政府機關已經使用生成式 AI 的同時發生。

stories.title: Meta's Muse 現在會幫你打電話給企業，但許多公司可能一聽到是 AI 就直接掛斷 / Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI

sources.title: Meta's Muse 現在會幫你打電話給企業，但許多公司可能一聽到是 AI 就直接掛斷 / Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.title_zh: Meta's Muse 現在會幫你打電話給企業，但許多公司可能一聽到是 AI 就直接掛斷
sources.title_en: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.title_original: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. The agent already has over 10 million users, according to Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang. Google Gemini, Instinct, and xAI's Grok Bot offer the same feature, but many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI on the line. The article Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta's AI 代理 Muse 現在可以代表付費的美國訂閱戶撥打電話給企業，從有線電視供應商到餐廳大小事都能處理。根據 Meta's AI 負責人 Alexandr Wang 的說法，該代理已經擁有超過 1,000 萬名用戶。Google Gemini、Instinct 和 xAI's Grok Bot 也提供相同功能，但許多企業一偵測到線上有 AI 就會直接掛斷電話。

After adding a card […]

sources.title: 語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型發佈：深度融合專業教學場景，爲全球師生與機構提供智能化服務

sources.title_original: 語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型發佈：深度融合專業教學場景，爲全球師生與機構提供智能化服務
sources.summary: 人工智能與垂直領域融合向縱深推進。據央視新聞報道，2026世界中文大會11月13日在北京開幕，會上發佈“語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型”。該模型面向全球中文學習者、一線教師和教育機構，提供全方位智能化服務，深度適配教與學全鏈路，覆蓋三大核心羣體，推動AI與國際中文教育實際需求深度融合。

sources.summary: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 發布了 Vercel UI SDK，這是一個包含 50 多種 UI 行為的 Apache-2.0 授權測試版函式庫。編碼代理程式可將它們組合成為 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components 的無障礙元件，並具備用於直接 UI 控制的橋接器。

stories.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限

sources.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.title_zh: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.title_original: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.summary: 一場網路攻擊，從取得受害系統的存取權限，到透過多個AI Agent協同執行攻擊，最後大規模蒐集存取憑證，可能不到六小時就能完成。攻擊者不再只是逐步尋找漏洞、手動執行攻擊，而是利用AI串聯不同階段的工作，在短時間內擴大攻擊規模。 Google威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence Group，GTIG）技術長Shane Huntley指出，AI並未從根本上改變網路攻擊的本質，卻讓攻擊者能以更快的速度、更大的規模執行既有攻擊。過去受限於人力與時間，攻擊者必須選擇目標；如今AI可以協助搜尋漏洞、分析系統及執行攻擊，企業原本認為風險不高的弱點，也可能成為入侵入口。

sources.title_original: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
sources.summary: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Perplexity Decider v1.3 與 Flash v1.3 是開權重（open-weight）決策模型，回傳的是機率而非文字。1.3 版本新增了用於片段提取的 Locate 功能，在 63 項查詢分類任務上回報了 91.6% 的平均準確率。

sources.title_zh: Google 發布 TPU Sync：針對 TPU 的開源 KV 快取傳輸技術
sources.title_en: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
sources.title_original: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
sources.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google 發布了 TPU Sync，這是一個開源的 C++ 程式庫，可在 TPU HBM、主機 DRAM、儲存設備和網路之間移動 KV 快取與權重。Google 報導指出，在 235B 至 480B MoE 模型上，KV 傳輸延遲降低了 90% 以上。

sources.title: 語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型發佈：深度融合專業教學場景，爲全球師生與機構提供智能化服務
sources.title_zh: 語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型發佈：深度融合專業教學場景，爲全球師生與機構提供智能化服務
sources.title_original: 語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型發佈：深度融合專業教學場景，爲全球師生與機構提供智能化服務
sources.summary: 人工智能與垂直領域融合向縱深推進。據央視新聞報道，2026世界中文大會11月13日在北京開幕，會上發佈“語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型”。該模型面向全球中文學習者、一線教師和教育機構，提供全方位智能化服務，深度適配教與學全鏈路，覆蓋三大核心羣體，推動AI與國際中文教育實際需求深度融合。

items.summary: 人工智能與垂直領域融合向縱深推進。據央視新聞報道，2026世界中文大會11月13日在北京開幕，會上發佈“語飛國際中文教育垂直大模型”。該模型面向全球中文學習者、一線教師和教育機構，提供全方位智能化服務，深度適配教與學全鏈路，覆蓋三大核心羣體，推動AI與國際中文教育實際需求深度融合。

sources.title: 銀行因美國出口管制，禁止中國與香港投資人參與 Anthropic 的 IPO / Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.title_zh: 銀行因美國出口管制，禁止中國與香港投資人參與 Anthropic 的 IPO
sources.title_en: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.title_original: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
sources.summary: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway. The article Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 《彭博社》報導，中國投資人被排除在 Anthropic's 的 IPO 之外。銀行以稱為 ITAR 的美國出口管制規則為由，拒絕來自中國大陸和香港的買入委託。SpaceX的 IPO 期間也適用類似的限制，而且 Anthropic's 的產品在兩個地區本來就無法使用。

sources.title: Meta's Muse 現在會幫你打電話給企業，但許多公司可能一聽到是 AI 就直接掛斷 / Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.title_zh: Meta's Muse 現在會幫你打電話給企業，但許多公司可能一聽到是 AI 就直接掛斷
sources.title_en: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.title_original: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
sources.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. The agent already has over 10 million users, according to Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang. Google Gemini, Instinct, and xAI's Grok Bot offer the same feature, but many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI on the line. The article Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta's AI 代理 Muse 現在可以代表付費的美國訂閱戶撥打電話給企業，從有線電視供應商到餐廳大小事都能處理。根據 Meta's AI 負責人 Alexandr Wang 的說法，該代理已經擁有超過 1,000 萬名用戶。Google Gemini、Instinct 和 xAI's Grok Bot 也提供相同功能，但許多企業一偵測到線上有 AI 就會直接掛斷電話。

sources.title: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 將 AI 直接接入工廠軟體以自動化工業工作流程 / Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 將 AI 直接接入工廠軟體以自動化工業工作流程
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
sources.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that. The article Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 外掛程式將 AI 直接連線到 Autodesk Fusion、Oracle NetSuite 和 Infor。其 17 項專業技能讓 AI 能夠在獲得人工核准後，起草報價單、比較供應商並在交貨延遲時下達備份訂單。該外掛程式目前尚未控制實體機械，但 Anthropic 正在為此單獨開發模型硬體標準（Model Hardware Standard）。

sources.title_zh: Google 發布 TPU Sync：針對 TPU 的開源 KV 快取傳輸技術
sources.title_en: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
sources.title_original: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
sources.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google 發布了 TPU Sync，這是一個開源的 C++ 程式庫，可在 TPU HBM、主機 DRAM、儲存設備和網路之間移動 KV 快取與權重。Google 報導指出，在 235B 至 480B MoE 模型上，KV 傳輸延遲降低了 90% 以上。

sources.title: XYBench：協助解決問題背後的真正問題 / XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.title_zh: XYBench：協助解決問題背後的真正問題
sources.title_en: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.title_original: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
sources.summary_zh: 真正實用的 AI 助理需要能夠協助提出誤導性問題的使用者，而不僅僅是那些用適當詳細程度提出正確問題的使用者。我們推出了 XYBench，這是一個包含 8K+ 個問題的基準測試，用於測試 AI 助理如何回應基於誤解的請求，例如詢問如何讓從杯子蛋糕上滑落的糖霜變濃稠，但真正的問題是杯子蛋糕還太溫暖而不適合塗糖霜。XYBench 在 EMNLP 2026 上榮獲最佳資源論文獎。

sources.title_en: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models
sources.title_original: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models
sources.summary: Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue says he has produced the first technical evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group are using Nvidia's latest Blackwell GPUs despite US export controls. His forensic method reads characteristic chip signatures directly from published model weights. He estimates the hardware behind the five training runs cost more than half a billion dollars. The article Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models appeared first on The Decoder .

events.news_summary: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet 取代 Instant Checkout，用戶以 Face ID 或指紋確認購買，卡號由支付令牌隱藏。

sources.title: OpenAI 透過 ChatGPT Wallet 從頭重建人工智慧購物 / OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 透過 ChatGPT Wallet 從頭重建人工智慧購物
sources.title_en: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.title_original: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
sources.summary: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases. The article OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 在放棄其第一種方法 Instant Checkout 後，透過 ChatGPT Wallet 再次嘗試人工智慧驅動的購物。使用者註冊一次卡片後，即可透過 Face ID 或指紋確認每筆購買，而實際的卡片詳細資訊則隱藏在支付代幣後面。諸如 Anthropic、Meta 和 xAI 等競爭對手已經有其代理程式在進行購物。

events.news_summary: 近70%美國政府機構已使用生成式AI，工會正推動反AI監控與自動解僱保護。

sources.title: 近 70% 的美國機關使用生成式 AI，而工會終於迎頭趕上並建立防護措施 / Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.title_zh: 近 70% 的美國機關使用生成式 AI，而工會終於迎頭趕上並建立防護措施
sources.title_en: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.title_original: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.summary: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI. The article Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 美國公部門工會正日益推動針對 AI 監控和自動化解僱的保護措施。在奧克蘭，一次罷工投票迫使資方實施再培訓計畫以取代裁員，而俄亥俄州的一個運輸工會則贏得了對自動駕駛車輛的否決權。加州禁止了所謂的「老闆軟體」（bossware）。所有這些都在近 70% 的美國政府機關已經使用生成式 AI 的同時發生。

sources.summary: Jensen Huang likely left Nvidia more because of risky business practices than anything else, a Wall Street Journal report suggests. At the very least, those practices made him enemies internally. The company offered cloud providers billions in financial guarantees for chip purchases, including a planned $250 billion deal with OpenAI. Interim CEO and then-CFO Colette Kress tried to contain the risk, and Huang reportedly didn't like that. The article Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary_zh: llama.cpp 讓在各種硬體上執行多模態 LLMs 成為可能——從消費級的本地機器到高階企業伺服器。透過量化、最佳化的後端以及可攜式的 C/C++ 實作，我們讓 AI 推論在軟體堆疊的每個層級都易於使用。我們相信這是建構跨平臺與隱私 AI 產品最輕量、最具多功能性且最合理的平臺。

sources.title_original: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
sources.summary: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.title_en: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
sources.title_original: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 發布了 Vercel UI SDK，這是一個包含 50 多種 UI 行為的 Apache-2.0 授權測試版函式庫。編碼代理程式可將它們組合成為 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components 的無障礙元件，並具備用於直接 UI 控制的橋接器。

sources.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.title_zh: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.title_original: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
sources.summary: 一場網路攻擊，從取得受害系統的存取權限，到透過多個AI Agent協同執行攻擊，最後大規模蒐集存取憑證，可能不到六小時就能完成。攻擊者不再只是逐步尋找漏洞、手動執行攻擊，而是利用AI串聯不同階段的工作，在短時間內擴大攻擊規模。 Google威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence Group，GTIG）技術長Shane Huntley指出，AI並未從根本上改變網路攻擊的本質，卻讓攻擊者能以更快的速度、更大的規模執行既有攻擊。過去受限於人力與時間，攻擊者必須選擇目標；如今AI可以協助搜尋漏洞、分析系統及執行攻擊，企業原本認為風險不高的弱點，也可能成為入侵入口。

Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents

Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control.
